# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** Concerning the manifestation of Divine Wisdom — the occasion when it came forth revealing its perceptible form — it did not come so that it might disclose its form to the ruling evils and falsities governing the mind. Rather, it came and manifested throughout the whole mind because of the interior spiritual life and the Divine truth proceeding from it, which is [GAP-1] every [GAP-2], that it might quicken that truth into life [GAP-3] and accomplish its liberation; and to free the interior spiritual life from every falsity and all the constraints in which it is entangled and held captive.

---

**¶3:** Still, observe and perceive this: the ruling evils and dominant falsities, in that they possessed no genuine form in [GAP-4] him, conceived a devouring desire for his perceptible likeness. They reflected upon themselves, that [GAP-5: REVIEW they] had no [GAP-6: REVIEW one] resembling him anywhere in their own productions. They impressed his likeness upon their will, within their interior life. Afterwards, they constructed an external semblance according to that likeness; they fashioned the natural will and the natural understanding — the outward human. They impressed the form of the Divine upon their [GAP-7: REVIEW interior life]. Thus they reproduced it as an imitation; but they have not reproduced it in truth. Rather, just as [GAP-8] it is made as these things are, for it came forth [GAP-9] but it does not truly correspond to the Divine. [GAP-10: REVIEW In like manner] is this semblance of the human form. They fashioned it in counterfeit of the form of the Divine [GAP-11].

---

**¶4:** Similarly, perception itself: for while it resembles the [GAP-12 — the genuine Divine perception, it is] not reproduced in truth.

---

**¶7:** Now, this is also the manner of the proceeding of Divine Wisdom in its third manifestation — when it came and revealed its perceptible form openly toward all the spiritual powers. [GAP-13: REVIEW It did] not come so that all the ruling evils and dominant falsities would construct an outward semblance after its likeness. Rather, it came because of its Divine truth being held captive and dispersed throughout every state of the mind; for it would liberate that truth, set it free, and rescue it from the domination of evil. Yet, when the ruling evils beheld it, they conceived a devouring desire for its form. They fashioned after its likeness the natural will and the natural understanding — the outward human — apart from the consent of the Divine Itself.

---

**¶9:** Understand also this further reality that I will teach you. For, just as the natural will and understanding were fashioned by the ruling evils and impressed after the form of the Divine, so too a manifold array of spiritual goods and many powers and intelligences [GAP-14 — received] the impress of that form which was manifested to them. For, in the majesty of Divine wisdom and the warmth of its Divine love, they burned with their longing and were dissolved from their former state. They were driven by their desire;

---

**¶10:** This is also the case with those spiritual powers: when they beheld that majestic and beautiful manifestation, they [GAP-15] produced a first likeness. They received the impress of that form which was manifested to them. They reproduced [GAP-16 — that which] they reproduced as an outward semblance, it being made [GAP-17] — those productions that they had brought forth, which had received an impress of this form. But even down into the most hardened and external natural states [GAP-18] which occur from state to state. The {GAP-19} of that form which was manifested throughout the whole mind [GAP-20] they received its impress, it being revealed there — an inscription upon their very substance.

---

**¶11:** Now, this new origination that they generated in a new [GAP-21] in the natural plane of the mind is the natural will and the natural understanding. [GAP-22: REVIEW There is not a] form in their domain since the very beginning like it; because that Divine likeness does not originate in the lower states of the mind.

---

**¶12:** Not all the external forms that have been fashioned were fashioned through generation by means of open conjunction of affection and thought. Rather, there are other forms fashioned [GAP-23] by different means.

---

**¶13:** One of these is the monstrous falsity of the natural mind — the residue cast off from the sphere of spiritual influence — which the [GAP-24: REVIEW Divine Source] of spiritual life discharged into the aggregate of natural knowledge. Its own self-love and its own cogitation fashioned it [GAP-25: REVIEW into] a determinate form.

---

**¶14:** The second form is the one [GAP-26: REVIEW that] descended into the lowest natural state. It made the aggregate of natural knowledge its containing matrix. Its own perverted desire became its shaping force. It alone fashioned itself into a nature which is the origin of spiritual death. Yet, when it rose up out of the aggregate of natural knowledge, it [GAP-27] sought to destroy the living works [GAP-28] of the Divine Source. Immediately there was sent against it the Indestructible Divine Truth — the great teaching of spiritual power. It subdued this evil in the cold states devoid of all love. It has trampled it underfoot and established itself upon it, throughout the entire duration of the natural state.

---

**¶15:** [GAP-29: REVIEW The] third form is the nature that descended upon the external natural mind. It fashioned a form of perception and established itself within it. [GAP-30] The new form that was fashioned [GAP-31] manifests itself there.

---

**¶16:** So, according to their essential nature they [GAP-32 — partake of falsity from evil]; but yet they did not arrive together with the sovereign evil itself into the natural plane of the mind. Rather, their formation [GAP-33: REVIEW came] about [GAP-34] as compound states — mixtures of good and evil, truth and falsity — and have been manifested upon the natural plane.

Still, you, look and see! The rulers and the authorities, in that they had no form in [likeness to] him, they lusted for his image. They reflected upon themselves, that [they] had no [one] like him in their creation. They sealed hi[s im]a[g]e in their heart, within their soul. Afterward[s, they] built it according to his likeness; they formed Adam and [Ev]e. They sealed the image of the exalted one in their [soul]. Yet, when it came up from the sea, it [sought] that it might destroy the works [of the Father] of Life. They immediately sent against it the Adamant of Light, the great 'instruction of vigour'. He humbled it in the districts of the north. He has trampled underfoot and set h[im]self upon it, until the end of the world.

fills.explanation: Directly parallels ¶7's "his son being crucified in the totality"; the Living Soul (Divine truth) is crucified/dispersed throughout every place in matter, corresponding to the Manichaean Cross of Light.
Standard Manichaean expression for the universal dispersal of the Living Soul; "every place" parallels ¶7's "the totality" and describes light scattered throughout all states of the natural mind.
The Ambassador came to restore the captive son to life — "live again" expresses the spiritual quickening of Divine truth from its entangled state back into living activity.

The rulers possessed no form resembling the Ambassador, which is why they lusted for his image; "no form in likeness to him" is clarified by the next sentence: "they had no one like him in their creation."
The rulers reflected upon themselves and recognized that they had no one like the Ambassador; "they" is the correct subject referring back to the rulers and authorities.
The rulers recognized they had no being ("one") in their creation who resembled the Ambassador's majestic form; confirmed by the spiritual reading's "no one resembling him."
Consistent with the earlier phrase in the same paragraph — "They sealed his image in their heart, within their soul" — and corresponds to the spiritual reading's "interior life."
The imitation came forth (was produced) but does not truly correspond to the original Divine image; "came forth" describes the emergence of the copied form into manifestation.
The editorial guess fits well as a standard transitional phrase drawing a parallel; it matches the spiritual reading's "In like manner" and the Kephalaia's expository register.

The chapter repeatedly qualifies "the image of the exalted one" with the phrase describing its display; "that was displayed" completes the reference to the Ambassador's revealed form that was counterfeited.

In Manichaean cosmology the fashioned tree imitates the Tree of Life; in Swedenborg the Tree of Life corresponds to genuine Divine perception — the spiritual reading confirms "genuine Divine perception."
Directly parallels ¶2's construction "he did not come so that he might reveal his image to the rulers"; confirmed by the spiritual reading and the chapter's repeated pattern.
The parallel "so too this is how" requires a connective showing these beings likewise received the stamp; "also received" completes the analogy with the fashioning of Adam and Eve.

The chapter's dominant verb for the rulers' creative act upon seeing the image is "fashioned"; the spiritual reading's "produced" confirms an act of making, and "fashioned a first image" fits the Kephalaia register.
Simple pronominal object — "They copied it, which they copied out in a likeness" — referring back to the first image; the spiritual reading's "that which" confirms the referential function.

The paragraph describes how the displayed image left its impress everywhere; "the likeness of that image" identifies what was received as a stamp, using the chapter's central vocabulary of image-correspondence.
Connects the displayed image to the reception of its stamp — "from it they received a stamp" — indicating the image as the source of the impress received throughout the universe.

The next sentence states "There is not a form in their world since the beginning like it," directly echoing and explaining the unprecedented "new form"; the new birth was begot in a new form never seen before.
The editorial choice correctly captures the emphatic denial — no prior form in the rulers' world resembles this new creation; confirmed by the spiritual reading's identical phrasing.

Contrasts with "fashioned by birth from displayed intercourse"; the spiritual reading confirms "by different means," and the following examples (sea giant, earth creature, tree nature) illustrate these alternative modes of fashioning.
"Father of Life" is a standard Manichaean divine title; the spiritual reading's "Divine Source of spiritual life" corresponds precisely to the Father of Life who discharged the residue into the sea.
The preposition "in" before "a figure" expresses the self-love and cogitation fashioning the residue into a determinate form; confirmed by the spiritual reading's "into a determinate form."
Standard relative pronoun introducing the description of the second figure — "the one that fell to the earth"; confirmed by the spiritual reading.

The creature rose from the sea with destructive intent; "sought" expresses purposeful effort toward destruction, matching the spiritual reading's "sought to destroy" and the purposive clause "that it might destroy."

Completes "the works of the Father of Life" — the creature sought to destroy the cosmological works of the Father of Life; the spiritual reading's "of the Divine Source" corresponds to "of the Father" in Manichaean terminology.
Simple definite article opening the description of the third figure, following the pattern of "The second figure is..." established in the previous paragraph.
Introduces the identification of the new figure fashioned in the tree, following the Kephalaia's standard demonstrative construction for identifying correspondential realities.

Resumptive pronoun construction common in Coptic — "the new figure that was fashioned, there it displays" — with "there" referring to the tree and "it" resuming the subject; matches the spiritual reading's "manifests itself there."

Expresses ontological origin — "they are from the darkness" — creating the essential contrast with "but they did not come with the King of Darkness"; the spiritual reading's "partake of falsity from evil" confirms their origin in darkness.
The editorial choice is correct — "their fashioning came about" is a standard expression for origination; confirmed by the spiritual reading's identical phrasing.

Connects the fashioning to its result — "came about, and so they are composite" — indicating that their formation resulted in compound states of mixed good and evil, matching the spiritual reading's description of mixture.
